findings.suggestion: animações de protótipo
findings.reason: Missing preposition; noun-noun juxtaposition is ungrammatical in Portuguese.

findings.span: É uma solução prática e rápida
findings.suggestion: É uma solução prática, com um clique,
findings.reason: English says 'a practical, one-click solution'; the translation replaces 'one-click' with 'rápida' (fast), changing the claim and losing the one-click feature mentioned elsewhere on the page.

findings.suggestion: logos semitransparentes de canto
findings.reason: English 'semi-transparent, corner logos' describes one type of logo (semi-transparent logos in a corner); 'ou' turns it into two alternatives.

findings.suggestion: marca d'água de pré-visualização
findings.reason: 'preview' should use the required pt-BR UI translation 'pré-visualização' rather than being left in English.

findings.suggestion: difíceis de reconstruir com inpainting
findings.reason: 'inpaintar' is an invented verb a native pt-BR speaker would not write; elsewhere the text uses the noun 'inpainting'.

findings.suggestion: manter o enquadramento no sujeito por mais tempo
findings.reason: In film context 'subject' means the person/object being filmed; 'assunto' means 'topic' and is a mistranslation. Other parts of the page correctly use 'sujeito' (FAQ: 'pose do sujeito'), so this is also inconsistent.

findings.suggestion: um clipe de entrada
findings.reason: 'Entrada' is capitalized mid-sentence in running prose (also occurs in 'último quadro da sua Entrada' and 'último quadro da Entrada'), which reads as an incorrect orthography in Portuguese narrative text.

findings.span: Seedance 2.0 - Extend Video é um fluxo de trabalho
findings.suggestion: Seedance 2.0 - Estender Vídeo é um fluxo de trabalho
findings.reason: The workflow name is left in English here while the page title was translated as 'Seedance 2.0 - Estender Vídeo'; inconsistent naming across the same entry.

findings.suggestion: gerar quadros extras
findings.reason: Uses the English loanword 'frames' while the rest of the page consistently uses 'quadros' (also 'um frame de correspondência' in the next item); inconsistent terminology within the entry.

findings.span: Carregue o fluxo de trabalho Qwen-Image em ComfyUI.
findings.suggestion: Carregue o fluxo de trabalho Qwen-Image no ComfyUI.
findings.reason: Missing definite article: pt-BR normally uses 'no ComfyUI' rather than 'em ComfyUI'.

findings.suggestion: armazenar a saída
findings.reason: Mid-sentence capitalization of a common noun; 'Saída' should be lowercase here since it is not a UI label.

findings.suggestion: texto de entrada
findings.reason: Mid-sentence capitalization of a common noun; 'Entrada' should be lowercase in running prose.

findings.suggestion: use o fluxo de trabalho do trocador de penteado para testar várias opções de cabelo

findings.suggestion: usando as entradas preparadas anteriormente
findings.reason: Source says 'inputs prepared upstream'; 'inputs' should be 'entradas', not 'parâmetros' (parameters is a different term used elsewhere in the same paragraph).

findings.suggestion: uma pré-visualização rápida image-to-video
findings.reason: 'Preview' is rendered as 'Pré-visualização' in the metaDescription but as 'prévia' here; the glossary requires 'Pré-visualização'. Inconsistent within the same entry.

findings.suggestion: PASSO 1 – PREVIS STILL FRAME (or keep canvas group labels consistently in English)
findings.reason: On-canvas group labels are handled inconsistently: 'STEP 1 – PREVIS STILL FRAME' is translated while 'INPUT SCENE DESCRIPTION' is left in English in howToUse/FAQ, so users cannot reliably match the text to the labels in the workflow.

findings.span: um setup médio de quadra de tênis
findings.suggestion: um enquadramento médio-aberto (medium-wide) em quadra de tênis
findings.reason: 'medium-wide' is a shot size; translating it as 'setup médio' drops the 'wide' component and reads as a vague 'medium setup' rather than a camera framing.

findings.span: valide figurino, props e fundo antes da gravação
findings.suggestion: valide figurino, adereços e fundo antes da gravação
findings.reason: 'props' is left untranslated English in an otherwise Portuguese sentence; the standard pt-BR term is 'adereços' (or 'objetos de cena').
